about: Second held-out set: written on 2026-11-20, after the 0.1.1 changes were made and frozen, and before any model answered. Its tools (get_restaurant, get_event, get_train, get_hotel, get_article) were new then: results with lists of reviews, times written as "9:0", and text to quote from. Times, quotes and summaries are judged by hand (no values listed). Same format as questions.json.
